final: WITH mixes AS (SELECT COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, '(missing)') AS mix, COUNT(*) AS mix_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, '(missing)')), shares AS (SELECT mix, mix_count, 1.0 * mix_count / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share FROM mixes), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT mix, mix_count, share, share - avg_share AS above_average_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN avg_share WHERE share > avg_share
